relationships.subject: trigeminal neuropathic pain
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings collectively indicate a reduction in excitability of LHb GABAergic neurons in the context of orofacial pain.

relationships.subject: LHb GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: These findings confirm that GABAergic neurons in the LHb form inhibitory connections with the pPVT.

relationships.subject: LHb GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Collectively, these findings suggest that LHb GABAergic neurons establish inhibitory synaptic connections with neighboring glutamatergic neurons, influencing both pain and anxiety behaviors.

relationships.subject: LHb GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Behavioral assessments, including the elevated plus maze (EPM) and open field test (OFT), demonstrated that this stimulation significantly reduced anxiety-like behaviors associated with nerve injury

relationships.subject: LHb GABAergic neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: Optogenetic stimulation (473 nm, 20 Hz, 5 mw, 20 ms) of LHb GABAergic neurons substantially alleviated primary (V2) and secondary mechanical allodynia (V3), as well as secondary cold allodynia

relationships.subject: pPVT neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: The hM4Di-CNO-mediated inhibition of pPVT resulted in a significant reduction in both primary and secondary mechanical allodynia, as well as secondary cold allodynia

relationships.subject: beta-sitosterol
relationships.evidence_quote: The presence of β-sitosterol in the bath solution significantly increased the number of action potentials within these neurons, an effect that was reversed by the ESRα inhibitor, AZD9496

relationships.subject: beta-sitosterol
relationships.evidence_quote: Intriguingly, β-sitosterol, known as an ESRα agonist, possesses analgesic, anxiolytic, and antidepressant properties

key_findings: In a trigeminal neuralgia (pT-ION) mouse model, LHb GABAergic neuron excitability is reduced; activating them relieves allodynia and anxiety, while inhibiting them in sham mice induces both.

LHbGABA->pPVT projections mainly relieve pain, whereas local LHbGABA->LHbGlu inhibition relieves both pain and anxiety; beta-sitosterol excites LHb GABAergic neurons via ESRalpha and is analgesic and anxiolytic.
